platform: SUPER airframe, candidate long landing-gear assembly and 0.28 m Qingyu arm
scope: Kinematic qualification on one known occupancy map. The archive contains model poses and planned paths.

environment.threads: One OpenBLAS and OpenMP thread for timed runs
environment.pythonpath: MuJoCo dependencies, mujoco_closed_loop, and the catkin planning package's src directory

gate_sections.negative_source: prescribed z=0.80 m at theta=118 deg, phi=180 deg and z=0.88 m at theta=0 deg; both at x=y=0
gate_sections.signed_contact_depth: native independent door model at the named pose
gate_sections.reported_clearance: conservative lower bound after attitude allowance; mission tracking reserve is a decision threshold

development_runs: Intermediate outputs stay in development/. Pass01 recorded a JSON serialization failure on a solver diagnostic sentinel. Pass02–04 exercised the corrections and new regression cases. The formal evidence is accepted/ at the pinned code revision.
paper: paper/round_d_geometry.tex in the paper/ tree (Appendix B, Figs. 10–11)
